title.en: Which printed window fits this check: what building window does Electric Low Pressure 60 print

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. A grid-powered building line that matches one of three stone rows. Read it in the Xingtai table. body.en: This block keeps the heading “Pressure Drop - SI units” from the reference article, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric Low Pressure 60, also marked Electric 75-60, prints 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm 100 m / 300 m and 24 mm 80 m / 240 m. Keep this cell as published. Fine stone is 150 m / 350 m. Taken from the printed row: Weight is 3500 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. The low-pressure 60 is 75 kW and 35 m³/h with the shorter distances above. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. That is a trailer pump for a building pipeline, not a compact 450 kg rural unit and not a spraying machine. Keep this cell as published. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Taken from the printed row: It is the model cell printed beside Electric Low Pressure 60. Read it in the Xingtai table. Fine stone is horizontal 150 m / vertical 350 m. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This page names no floor and no contract volume. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-schedule-80-friction-loss-diagram-d_1146.html
body.zh: 本节保留该来源页的标题“压力降国际单位单位”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动低压60，页上亦标 Electric 75-60：75 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa，细石 150 m / 350 m，13 mm 100 m / 300 m，24 mm 80 m / 240 m。这一格照已印出的读：已印外形是 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg，液压泵为川崎双泵 100。这是建筑管路用的拖泵，不是 450 kg 的农村紧凑机，也不是喷涂机。现场供不上 75 kW，就改开柴油的建筑或基建行，不要留在这个名字上。目录里已经写着：它是电动低压60旁边印出的型号格。不是这一页上另一台未公布的机器。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-schedule-80-friction-loss-diagram-d_1146.html

body.en: The section shape comes from “Pressure Drop - Imperial Units” in the reference article. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. A grid-powered building line that matches one of three stone rows. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. 13 mm stone is 100 m / 300 m. Keep this cell as published. The scenario text is building and commercial placement. Taken from the printed row: The shared “60” does not merge the tables. Read it in the Xingtai table. If the site cannot feed 75 kW, open a diesel building-or-infrastructure row instead of keeping this name. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Keep this cell as published. It is not a second unpublished machine on this page. Taken from the printed row: No.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自该来源页的“压力降英制单位”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：对得上三行石子之一的有电网建筑管路。邢台河北品锦机械把电动低压60 / Electric 75-60 列为 75 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.5 m³。细石 150 m / 350 m。13 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m。24 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m。重量 3500 kg。工况原文是建筑与商业浇筑。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请引用石子行，并确认能否供应 75 kW。这一格照已印出的读：不是。细石是水平 150 m / 垂直 350 m。

body.en: the reference article breaks its subject at “Friction Loss Table”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60 at 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa and hopper 0.5 m³. Read it in the Xingtai table. 24 mm stone is 80 m / 240 m. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric 60 is the high-rise electric row: 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 13 mm 150 m / 450 m, 24 mm 100 m / 300 m, weight 3300 kg. Keep this cell as published. The printed size is 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg, with a Kawasaki double pump 100. Taken from the printed row: Quote the stone row and confirm a supply for 75 kW. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue leaves that cell blank for. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Keep this cell as published. It is theoretical output. Headings already printed: Do not swap it with Electric 60
body.zh: 该来源页在“摩擦损失表”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。目录里已经写着：电动60是高层电动行：90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa，细石 200 m / 600 m，13 mm 150 m / 450 m，24 mm 100 m / 300 m，重量 3300 kg。低压60是 75 kW、35 m³/h，距离是上面较短的那一组。都叫“60”，表不能合并。按邢台表上的原文理解：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。旁边那一台不在这句话里。不是。它是理论输送量。本页不写楼层，也不写合同方量。已印出的标题：不要和电动60对调

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Pressure Drop - SI units” — What does Electric 75-60 mean?
question.zh: “压力降国际单位单位”旁边仍要印着的是什么：Electric 75-60 是什么？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It is the model cell printed beside Electric Low Pressure 60. It is not a second unpublished machine on this page.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。它是电动低压60旁边印出的型号格。不是这一页上另一台未公布的机器。

question.en: “Pressure Drop - Imperial Units” does not change the check: Is 350 m horizontal?
question.zh: “压力降英制单位”不改这一问：350 m 是水平吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. Fine stone is horizontal 150 m / vertical 350 m.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：不是。细石是水平 150 m / 垂直 350 m。

question.en: Is 35 m³/h a deck or floor volume, once the outline says “Friction Loss Table”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“摩擦损失表”时，35 m³/h 是某层楼的方量吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: No. It is theoretical output. This page names no floor and no contract volume.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：不是。它是理论输送量。本页不写楼层，也不写合同方量。
